QuestInfo.name: In search of Wing the Fairy
QuestInfo.0: I wonder how #p407#'s doing with the flying balloon... Maybe I should go check up on him in #m10003000#.
QuestInfo.1: Icarus's flying balloon didn't work out, but his quest for flight continues. This time, he wants to deviate from a scientific approach and opt for a magical one. He asked me to go see his best friend, #b#p309##k, in #m10002000#, the town of fairies. Apparently, #p309# knows how to make #b#t4031079##k... I'll need to go see him in #m10002000#, for #p407#'s sake.
QuestInfo.2: #p309# in #m10002000# dislikes humans so much that he wouldn't even listen to what I had to say.

0.0: Hey, you're the one that got me the materials for the flying balloon...\r\n#L0# #bDid you get it to work?#k#l
0.1: Oh, that... well... I faced MINOR, I mean, MIIINOR technical difficulties, and... Well, I don't know what's wrong!! Is it really an impossible dream to realize? All I wanted to do was to fly! I can't let this deter me from my ultimate goal! I can't be giving up this soon. Can you help me out one last time?

yes.0: I knew you'd help me out. I really appreciate it! Anyway, I have a fairy friend, and his name is #p309#. He lives in #m10002000#, so it's hard to see him frequently, but we're still really close.
yes.1: Since he is a fairy, I'm sure he knows a way to make me fly. Please find out what #b#p309##k has to offer, in terms of me flying! Since I live a long way from #m10002000#, I don't think I can go there myself. Can you go there for me and ask?

no.0: Even you have a hard time trusting me now... seriously, this one is FOR REAL! Why can't you trust me?

0.1: You're just like everyone else, living in a box. Wake up, think OUTSIDE the box! You'll see... You'll see me flying around here some day.

1.0: What business does a human have with me? Don't bother me. I don't want to waste my time.
